journey.title: Find out why everything is refusing
journey.purpose: The failure journey. The verification authority is unreachable, so act-as fails closed everywhere. The operator must reach a correct diagnosis quickly rather than concluding the product is broken.

steps.intent: Notice the view is labelled stale rather than silently showing old data as current.
Identify which dependency is down and understand that refusing is deliberate, not a bug.
Confirm the refusals were recorded with their reason, so nothing was silently permitted.
